name: b2t2
diagnosis: FDIR allows only one isolation. It isolates the first mild friction fault residual ~4.6e-04 Nm and consumes the slot, leaving the second more severe friction or dead wheel in control. With no dump hardware the 3-wheel control on a degraded set then diverges to attitude loss or saturation. Without isolation the cases pass.
rationale: Enable narrow swap to keep 3-wheel control on healthiest wheels: if a second wheel trips while one is isolated and its residual is 3x larger, re-enable the mild isolated wheel and isolate the worse one. Limit to mildly degraded isolated wheels <=0.0005 Nm so severely degraded wheels are never re-enabled. Fixes mild-first then severe-second pairs.
why_no_regressions: Very narrow: only triggers when isolated is mild and new is 3x worse. Preserves current first-isolation behavior in most runs. Prior hard-filter broke 4 runs with ratios ~2-4; ratio 3.0 blocks about half of those swaps.
gate_reason: rejected (budget): 4 previously clean runs broken (max 3), 4 runs with new violations, 2 fixes, net -2, 659 runs evaluated (stopped early)
sat_rule_recheck: 2026-11-04: re-decided on the consecutive-rule-corrected suite (data/satfix/gates_corrected.json); decision unchanged
